name: chess_fen_validate
description: Validate a chess position given in Forsyth-Edwards Notation (FEN): the six fields, piece and pawn counts, one king each, no pawns on the back ranks, castling rights consistent with the king and rook squares, a plausible en-passant square, the move counters, and that the side not to move is not in check; returns every problem found, a board diagram, who is in check and the material count.

strict_en_passant.description: Require that an en-passant capture is actually possible (newer convention)

catalog.source: FEN as specified in the Portable Game Notation Specification and Implementation Guide (Steven J. Edwards, 1994), section 16.1; legality rules of the FIDE Laws of Chess
